assessment.context_case: No Zubac-specific reporting was supplied. The table's excerpt is a partial snapshot, so his absence from it does not establish health. Pacers guard absences may shift possessions but do not clearly lower his rebounding.

qualitative_review.countercase: If Zubac's recent usage is genuinely limited near 23 minutes, or Denver controls the glass, the under at plus money is close to fair or slightly favorable.

assessment.model_case: The projection is 22.92 with a median of 22 against a 23.5 line, a modest cushion. Teammate absences are not modeled. That matters only if the rolling sample understates Carter's current usage without Banchero and Suggs.

findings.note: On Nov 5, CBS/RotoWire reported Ighodaro would start against the Magic ahead of Khaman Maluach after four bench games, averaging 8.3 points in 20.8 minutes, which is above the 6.5 line; this result doesn't give Thursday's stats.
In the Nov 2 loss to the Warriors, Ighodaro scored 14 points on 6-of-6 shooting in 24 minutes off the bench and played 11 more minutes than starting center Khaman Maluach.

He missed late-October games with an oblique strain after leaving the opener with a right hip injury. He has since been cleared, but the injury history is a minutes risk; Mark Williams is out for months after shoulder surgery, which raises Ighodaro's role.

Brooks averaged 20.2 points, 3.6 rebounds and 1.8 assists in 2025-26, about 25.6 points + rebounds + assists, which is well above 21.5, and he averaged 26 points in the playoffs. No game logs from this season turned up to check whether that output has continued.

A July Rotowire note said Phoenix's trade for Miles Bridges could squeeze shots and touches among the starters and change Brooks's role. He was also expected to miss an Oct 14 preseason game. Nothing found covers his injury status for this game.

This total depends heavily on his scoring. The Athletic says he grabbed only 3.6 rebounds and made 1.8 assists last season, and his 3-point shooting fell to 34.4%, so a cold shooting night could put him under.
